display_long_description:
**Your planet is gone.**

Your replicator regenerated you on an alien world. You’re stranded.

Starworn is a voxel survival adventure built for VR. Start with what you can find and build a base to call home. The wilderness won’t make it easy.

[media]

**Made by hand.**

Fell trees and mine the terrain. Saw logs into planks, smelt ore and forge your own blades. Each bench is worked by hand.

[media]

[media]

[media]

**Around the campfire.**

Cook what you find and keep yourself fed.

[media]

**Stand your ground.**

Skeletons come in packs. Black knights hit back. Craft swords, bows, bombs, a blade that flies back to your hand and plasma weapons.

[media]

[media]

**Beyond the surface.**

Old ruins are guarded by skeletons, caves hide giant spiders, and a robot keep guards its vault. Invite friends and head underground together.

[media]

[media]

**The world changes.**

Forests turn to autumn colours and snow. When night falls, bring a torch.

[media]

**Early Access**

The first world is playable now, and we keep updating it. Future updates will expand the journey: your own spaceship, other worlds and the search for survivors, and whoever destroyed your planet.

Tell us what you want next. Your feedback helps decide what we build.

Join at a lower launch price. We plan to raise it after the first round of feedback and improvements, and again as the game grows. Early buyers receive all future base-game updates, including the full release, at no extra cost.

Expect bugs and unfinished features. Some updates may require a new world. Buy for what’s playable today.
